Message:
The hare stood alone,
at the edge of
their crumbling world.

The many conflicts
across the lands
had supposedly been resolved.
But the seeds of mistrust
still lingered in
the hearts of the animals.

Although they had
supposedly reconciled,
the mouse lured the cat to
a trap disguised as
a feast of gratitude,
ultimately costing
the cat their life.

The wolf and the bear
resented anyone who dared
stand above them,
so they ambushed and killed
their mediator, the tiger.

The nations that were once swayed
by the cunning bat
betrayed the owl,
burying her along with her books.

And as for the tortoise...
his sturdy shell was shattered,
as he lay cold and lifeless.

All around him,
the animals were fighting over
the very staff he used to help them.

“That dumb slowpoke managed
to save the world!”
“What’s stopping me
from doing the same?”
“I can do it too!”

They carelessly trampled over
the tortoise’s body,
as they fought to claim
the staff for themselves.

and before she knew it,
her white fur became
stained in deep black.

After laying the tortoise to rest,
the hare stood at
the edge of the world...
and threw herself into the abyss.
